name: paper-digger
description: Checkpoint-gated academic research orchestration from direction discovery to verified submission artifacts.

interface.shortDescription: Checkpoint-gated research from idea to submission
interface.longDescription: Plan and run an academic research project through explicit human checkpoints, falsifiable experiments, evidence verification, theory checks, drafting, review, revision, and final formatting.
defaultPrompt: Start a checkpoint-gated research project from my constraints.
Resume this Paper Digger workspace and tell me the next gate.
Red-team the current evidence and issue a go/no-go verdict.
